decisions.statement: A type declares every property every type above that type declares.
The nearer declaration decides the file a property's declaration defaults.
Which types declare a secret is answered here rather than by the caller.
Which types declare a value kept outside the commit is answered the same way.
A declaration fixing a file property's value declares that file as a default does.
A declaration naming a file property group declares a file for each member.
A member is named by the group's slug and then the member's slug.
A member is kept outside the commit where its own declaration says so or the group's does.
A page type that is a file property group declares nothing of its own beside its pages.
Nothing here says where a declared file sits.

definition: the files a page type declares beside every page of that type
